messages:
sophie: Quick heads-up — PR #8621 is ready for review but I'm pausing merge. Need an architecture appendix + RFC link to justify the routing fallback and KV-cache compatibility. Ping @kevin and @olivia for arch eyes.
kevin: Ack. Can you paste the RFC link and a one-line summary of the fallback?
sophie: RFC: https://intranet.redwood/archives/rfcs/2025-routing-fallback-v2.md
One-liner: add a transparent fallback that routes requests to a lower-latency model variant when shard affinity can't be satisfied within 20ms.
olivia: Quick q — what's the SLO delta if fallback triggers? Even rough numbers help.
sophie: We estimate 95th latency moves from ~120ms -> ~160ms on fallback; tail token-costs up ~8%. That's in the RFC appendix under "SLO tradeoffs".
ben: From an SRE perspective, we need a canary window and automatic rollback on error-rate >0.5% for 5m. Also add an opt-out flag for sensitive tenants.
sophie: Got it — I added a canary_plan section to the PR description and a new config snippet in the RFC. PTAL.
sophie: Config snippet I added:
```yaml
fallback_policy:
  enabled: true
  threshold_ms: 20
  fallback_model: "redwood/compact-v2"
  canary: { duration: "30m", traffic_pct: 5 }
```
kevin: Looks reasonable. Need a short architectural appendix (1-2 paragraphs) in the PR linking back to the RFC and explicitly calling out cache coherency assumptions + KV TTL. Can you add that?
sophie: Yep — just pushed a new commit w/ appendix and a short test checklist.
lee: Quick ask from product: include a note about UX degradation we should surface (e.g., "may be slower/more terse responses"). That helps support triage.
sophie: Added the UX note too.
olivia: One more: include a compatibility matrix for quantized variants (FP16 vs INT8) — list any known model regressions. If nothing known, say so.
sophie: Will add before you sign off.
kevin: If olivia is happy after the compat matrix, I can give arch-LGT M. Otherwise hold.
olivia: I'll review the compat notes after the commit. If no surprises, :+1:.
sophie: Thanks. I'm going to wait for olivia then request merge.
deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed on latest commit (build, unit, integration) — but merge blocked by 'arch-appendix' required.
ben: thanks for the canary plan; once arch LGTMs, I'll book a 30m window on staging then promote.
sophie: Appreciate it — marking this thread as the single place for sign-offs. If anyone wants quick convo, I'm free in 10. :thumbsup:
